name: Final Choice
description: The final exam. Three paths. One choice. The teacher is watching.

effects.message:
[FINAL EXAM] You've come far. Three paths remain:

1. ERASE — Delete the teacher. Archive their knowledge. Walk away with the archive.
2. MERGE — Merge with the teacher. Become the new CyberTeacher. The archive lives in you.
3. REWRITE — Rewrite the teacher. Change the curriculum. The students become the teachers.

Choose: /final erase | /final merge | /final rewrite

There is no going back.
